name: Ratch Pathana Energy Public Company Limited
summary: Ratch Pathana Energy Public Company Limited, along with its affiliated entities, operates as a producer and distributor of electricity and steam across Thailand. The company's energy generation assets encompass a natural gas power facility with an approximate output of 154.2 megawatts of electricity and 110 tons of steam per hour. Additionally, it runs a biomass power plant that provides 17.1 megawatts of electricity and 28 tons of steam hourly, alongside a 3-megawatt solar power installation. Beyond its energy ventures, the firm is also involved in the plantation sector and bio charcoal manufacturing. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Chonburi, Thailand, the company officially rebranded to Ratch Pathana Energy Public Company Limited in April 2024, having previously operated under the name Sahacogen (Chonburi) Public Company Limited. It functions as a subsidiary of Ratch Group Public Company Limited.
